verified_facts.text: Hotel Des Indes is located on the Lange Voorhout in The Hague.
verified_facts.excerpt: is located at one of the most beautiful spots in Royal The Hague, on the leafy Lange Voorhout

verified_facts.text: The Binnenhof, Noordeinde Palace, the Mauritshuis, Museum Escher in het Paleis and Panorama Mesdag are all close to the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Binnenhof with the Hofvijver, Noordeinde Palace, the Lower House, the Mauritshuis, Museum Escher in het Paleis, and Panorama Mesdag are all just a stone's throw away.

verified_facts.text: The restaurant's chandeliers, draperies and seating recall the era when Des Indes was a town palace where heads of state were entertained.
verified_facts.excerpt: The chandeliers, draperies and comfortable seats in the Restaurant are a living monument to the era that Des Indes was a town palace, where heads of state were entertained.

verified_facts.text: High Tea is served daily in the Lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt:
**High Tea - Lounge**

Daily at 1:00 PM, 1:30 PM, or 2:00 PM.

verified_facts.text: The Des Indes Lounge & Restaurant serves lunch, dinner a la carte and a three-course chef's menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: delicious lunch or dinner à la carte or a 3-course menu du Chef at the Des Indes Lounge & Restaurant

verified_facts.text: The chef's dishes are created from premium products of Dutch origin.
verified_facts.excerpt: the delicious dishes that the Chef has created from premium quality products of Dutch origin

verified_facts.text: Private dining is available for special occasions.
verified_facts.excerpt: For special occasions to be shared with a select company of people.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a large balcony with a view of Lange Voorhout and The Hague skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: From the large balcony you have a beautiful view of Lange Voorhout and the distinctive The Hague skyline.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a bathroom with a steam cabin and a spacious living room.
verified_facts.excerpt: luxurious bathroom (including steam cabin) and spacious living room

verified_facts.text: Many celebrities and heads of state have stayed in the Presidential Suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: many celebrities and heads of state preceded you

verified_facts.text: Rooms come with Marie Stella Maris care products and a rain shower.
verified_facts.excerpt:
- Marie Stella Maris care products
- Rain shower

verified_facts.text: All rooms and suites are accessible for guests with disabilities, reached by elevator.
verified_facts.excerpt: All our rooms and suites are accessible for guests with disabilities. You can use one of our elevators to reach your accommodation.

verified_facts.text: The concierge helps plan bike routes and arranges rental bikes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our concierge is ready to help you compile the best bike routes and will make sure your rental bike is ready to go.

verified_facts.text: Hotel Des Indes is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
verified_facts.excerpt: As a proud member of The Leading Hotels of The World, Hotel Des Indes invites you to join the Leaders Club.

verified_facts.text: Junior Suites have large windows with daylight and a view over The Hague.
verified_facts.excerpt: The large windows provide plenty of daylight and offer a nice view over The Hague.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers event spaces with natural daylight for corporate and private events.
verified_facts.excerpt: Impressive spaces for both corporate and private events, featuring natural daylight in an exclusive and intimate setting.
